assessment.headline: DAY 32. Tanker struck near Dubai. Tehran blackout. Indian killed in Kuwait. But BW Tyr reaches Mumbai today. April 6 = 6 days.
assessment.body:
Iran struck a fully laden Kuwaiti oil tanker near Dubai — the biggest ship attack of the war. Israel hit Tehran's power grid, causing a blackout. Trump said he wants to 'take the oil in Iran.' 50,000+ US special forces are now in the region. And an Indian worker was killed in Kuwait when a strike hit a desalination plant — India's first confirmed civilian casualty in the Gulf.

But India's quiet Hormuz operation continues delivering: BW Tyr docks in Mumbai today with LPG. BW Elm reaches Mangalore tomorrow. 8 carriers have now crossed safely, delivering ~450,000+ MT of LPG and crude. 18 ships + 485 crew remain. Op Urja Suraksha has 5+ warships active.

Verified India numbers (Day 32):
• 28 ships at peak → 18 remain + 485 seafarers
• 8 carriers crossed (Shivalik, Nanda Devi, Jag Laadki, Pine Gas, Jag Vasant, 2 SCI, BW Tyr + BW Elm)
• 942+ seafarers repatriated
• Still waiting: Jag Vikram, Green Asha, Green Sanvi
• Sensex 71,948. Nifty 22,331. Rupee 94.84 ATL
• FII $12.3B outflow March. ₹44L+ Cr destroyed
• Excise cut ₹10/L. Indian basket $125/bbl. Brent $115+
• Indian worker killed in Kuwait — first Gulf casualty

The dual chokepoint threat remains: Hormuz is selectively open but Iran just proved it can strike even near Dubai. Houthis threaten Bab al-Mandeb. If both close, India's entire maritime supply is severed.

April 6 = 6 days. Pakistan hosting talks 'in coming days.' But Israel says it will NOT scale back before any talks. Pentagon has Kharg raid plans ready. The next week is the most consequential in India's energy security history.
